Privacy notice under Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR). Last updated: 01/11/2026.

## 1. Data controller
[to be completed], [to be completed] – VAT/Tax no. [to be completed] – email ilgiardinodirosa53@gmail.com – certified email (PEC) giardino.rosa@pec.it – tel. +39 338 68 92 300 (the «Controller»), operator of the accommodation «Il giardino di Rosa».

## 2. What data we process, why and on what legal basis
- **Bookings** are made on **Airbnb**, which collects and processes booking data as an independent controller under its own notice. The Controller receives from Airbnb the data needed to manage your stay (name, dates, number of guests, messages). Legal basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). This website does NOT take bookings or payments.
- **Messages from the contact form** (name, email, phone, text): to reply to you. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) or, for general enquiries, our legitimate interest in replying (Art. 6(1)(f)).
- **Legal obligations** during your stay: registration and communication of guest data to the police authority (Art. 109 Italian TULPS), tax and accounting duties, tourist tax where applicable. Legal basis: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)). Such data (including ID documents) is NOT collected through this website but on arrival.
- **Website security** (IP address, time of requests, login attempts): to prevent abuse and spam and protect the system. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)). These technical logs are kept for very short periods (see below).
- **Establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims**. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)).

We do not collect special categories of data (Art. 9 GDPR): please do not enter any in free-text fields. We do not profile you nor take automated decisions.

## 3. Providing your data
Fields marked as required are necessary to handle your request; without them we cannot proceed. Everything else is optional.

## 4. Who receives your data
- Hosting and email provider of the website (SiteGround or another provider designated by the Controller), appointed as processor (Art. 28 GDPR).
- The police «Alloggiati Web» portal, tax and municipal authorities, when required by law.
- Advisers (tax, legal, technical) bound by confidentiality.
- Airbnb, for bookings made on the platform (independent controller, with its own notice).
- Instagram (Meta): the website only contains a link to the profile, with no plugin or tracking; if you visit it, your data is processed by Meta under its own notice.
Your data is not sold or passed to third parties for marketing and is not disclosed publicly.

## 5. Map and third-party content
The map on the «Explore» page uses OpenStreetMap and is loaded **only after your explicit consent**. When loaded, your browser sends your IP address to the OpenStreetMap Foundation servers (United Kingdom, a country covered by an EU adequacy decision). Without consent no data is sent. Fonts are hosted on our own server; we use no analytics, advertising or social plugins.

## 6. Transfers outside the EEA
We do not intentionally transfer data outside the EEA. Should our hosting provider use servers outside the EEA, transfers would only take place with appropriate safeguards (Art. 44 et seq. GDPR).

## 7. Retention
- Messages from the contact form: 12 months, then deleted.
- Accounting and tax data for the stay: 10 years (civil and tax law).
- Security logs (rate limiting, login attempts): 24 hours at most.
- Guest registration data: as required by law.

## 8. Your rights
You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and object to processing based on legitimate interest (Arts. 15–22 GDPR) by writing to ilgiardinodirosa53@gmail.com. We reply within one month. If you believe the processing breaches the law you may lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it) or your local authority.

## 9. Minors
The website is not aimed at children under 14 and does not knowingly collect their data. Bookings on Airbnb are reserved for adults.

## 10. Security
We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures: encrypted HTTPS connection, protected admin access, attempt limiting, backups and data minimisation.

## 11. Changes
This notice may be updated; the date of the latest update is shown at the top.
